lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Two hundred and ninety megawatts. This is Meridian Actual's own anchor. You are defending the room I am sitting in.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: How did it get here?

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Through the ring, forty minutes ago, on a bind key this office sold.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: The fourth key.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: The fourth key. Non-essential personnel are evacuating through the secondary. Essential personnel are me.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact at the threshold. Engaging is your call, Captain, this is your board.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Control, are you reading the capacity trend on your side?

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Twelve a wave. The building is on the same bus you are.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Advisory: lighting has failed on levels two through five. This does not affect your tasking.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Control, get out of the room.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Negative. Somebody has to hold the —

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Yolanda, it's Dahl. I've been Control for eleven months and I never once —
lines.beat: the only time in the game Control breaks procedure, and it is cut off mid-sentence

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Meridian Actual. Say again your last, field lead.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: That's a different duty officer.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Over capacity — and this bus runs the building. Shed carefully.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One through the ring and into the building.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Hold the ring. Everything else is furniture.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor is held. Meridian Actual is operational.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Control, what's your name?

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Duty officer, Meridian Actual. Stand by for tasking.
